settings.title: Cold-shock response
settings.body: Cold water may trigger gasping, rapid breathing, increased heart rate and increased blood pressure. Sudden exposure can place stress on the heart and may cause panic, dizziness, loss of breathing control or fainting.

settings.title: Who should seek medical advice
settings.body:
Do not use KRYO without approval from a qualified healthcare professional if you are pregnant or have any known, suspected or previous:

  • Cardiovascular disease
  • Heart attack
  • Stroke or transient ischaemic attack
  • Heart rhythm disorder
  • Uncontrolled high blood pressure
  • Peripheral vascular disease
  • Poor circulation
  • Raynaud’s phenomenon
  • Diabetes with neuropathy, reduced sensation or circulation complications
  • Peripheral neuropathy
  • Cold urticaria
  • Cold allergy or severe cold sensitivity
  • Cold agglutinin disease, cryoglobulinaemia or another cold-reactive blood disorder
  • Cold-induced asthma
  • Serious respiratory condition
  • History of fainting, blackouts or seizures
  • Condition affecting temperature sensation or judgement
  • Medical condition or medication that may alter the response to cold

A condition not listed is not automatically safe. Seek advice if you are unsure.

settings.title: When not to use KRYO
settings.body:
• If you are under 18
  • If you have an open wound, active skin infection, significant rash or damaged skin in the exposure area
  • If you are unwell, feverish, dizzy, dehydrated or unusually fatigued
  • After alcohol or recreational drug use
  • While using medication that impairs judgement
  • Alone during early sessions if you do not yet know your response to intense cold
  • While performing breath holds, hyperventilation or extreme breathwork
  • If the product, PSU, cable, plug, hose, fittings or rail appear damaged
  • Where the PSU, outlet or cable connection may sit in water
  • If the rail is loose
  • If the reservoir is empty or frozen

settings.title: Stop immediately if
settings.body:
Stop the flow and move to a safe, warm environment if you experience:

  • Chest pain, pressure or tightness
  • Severe shortness of breath
  • Dizziness, faintness or loss of consciousness
  • Confusion
  • Loss of coordination
  • Severe weakness
  • Persistent numbness
  • Blue or unusually pale skin
  • Uncontrolled or prolonged shivering
  • Racing, irregular or unusually slow heartbeat
  • Panic
  • Inability to control breathing
  • Any unusual or concerning symptom

Seek urgent medical care for severe or persistent symptoms.

settings.title: First-flow position
settings.body:
Never begin with your face or chest directly under the Halo.

Start with your back to the Halo and water landing over the upper shoulders. Begin at a warmer temperature and lower flow. Rotate slowly only after breathing is controlled.

settings.title: Temperature safety
settings.body:
• Recommended first setting: approximately 15°C.
  • Never select below 1°C.
  • Never allow the reservoir to freeze.
  • Do not use temperature or duration as a competition.
  • End before control, coordination or normal breathing deteriorates.

settings.title: Breathing
settings.body: Breathe normally. Do not perform breath holds, hyperventilation or extreme breathwork while using KRYO.

settings.title: Electrical safety
settings.body:
• UAE wall supply is nominally 230V AC, 50 Hz.
  • Use only the supplied PSU and plug.
  • Verify the PSU rating label matches the local supply.
  • Keep the PSU, wall plug, outlet and cable connections dry.
  • Keep mains components outside the splash zone.
  • Do not touch plugs or connections with wet hands.
  • Do not operate in standing water.
  • Do not use a damaged cord, plug or PSU.
  • Do not use an unapproved extension lead.
  • Do not open, modify or repair KRYO.
  • Disconnect from mains before approved maintenance or storage.
  • Pull the plug, not the cable.

settings.title: Filling and pump safety
settings.body:
• Add the approved minimum priming volume before switching on.
  • Never run the pumps dry.
  • Never overfill.
  • Keep water below the marked safe level.
  • Use only clean water and approved ice.
  • Do not add salt, chemicals, oils or cleaning substances unless Everest Labs approves them.
  • Do not operate with a blocked or kinked hose.
  • Stop if water reaches the PSU or wall outlet.

settings.title: Installation safety
settings.body:
• Install on a stable, level surface.
  • Keep the rear air outlet clear.
  • Confirm hose, cable and refill reach before attaching the rail.
  • Install the rail only on an approved smooth surface.
  • Follow the approved surface preparation and adhesive cure time.
  • Inspect the rail before use.
  • Do not use the Halo if the rail is loose.
  • Keep water direction away from KRYO’s display and power side where possible.

settings.title: Product/medical disclaimer
settings.body: KRYO is a consumer wellness product. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or medical condition. Information provided by Everest Labs is general product information and is not a substitute for medical advice.

settings.heading: Important safety information.
settings.body: Cold exposure causes an immediate physiological stress response and may rapidly increase breathing, heart rate and blood pressure. Do not install or use KRYO until you have read this page. Begin at a warmer temperature and lower flow. Never direct the first flow at your face or chest. Never use KRYO while intoxicated, unwell or unable to respond normally.
